_note: One representative coordinate per PIN code: the real post-office point nearest the median of that PIN codes offices, rounded to 3dp (~110m). GeoNames coordinates for India are approximate (accuracy code 4) and some sit well outside the true PIN code area, so these are used only as a fallback when a district name cannot be matched, and only when the resolved district agrees with the delegates stated state. See renderDelegateMap() in public/app.js.
